subject: Ariba org ID reconciliation / tenant rebind for Palmetto Supplies
messages:
From: Clara Nguyen <clara@palmetto-supplies.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement-tech@palmetto-supplies.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Issue claiming Ariba invite — org ID appears incorrect

Hi Jordan / Aditya,

We tried to accept the supplier invite that was sent from Redwood last week but the Ariba claim flow fails at the tenant mapping step. The screen shows an org ID of "PALMETTO_OLD_123" which doesn't match the org ID on our side (we've historically been on "PAL-EXT-987"). Attached is a screenshot of the error page and an export of our supplier profile that shows the DUNS/VAT info.

We need the invites to route correctly so our POs will start flowing to our accounting system — currently POs are stuck in pending state. Can someone confirm which org ID Redwood used for the invite and advise next steps to reconcile?

Attachments: screenshot-ariba-orgid.png, supplier-profile-export.csv

Thanks,
Clara Nguyen
Procurement Ops Manager
Palmetto Supplies Ltd.
clara@palmetto-supplies.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Nguyen <clara@palmetto-supplies.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Issue claiming Ariba invite — org ID appears incorrect

Hi Clara — thanks for the heads up and for the attachments, they're helpful. We're going to triage this internally and outline a short mutual action plan so we can get PO routing resumed ASAP.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- Aditya will confirm the org ID we used to generate the invite and check our tenant mapping table.
- If there's a legacy org prefix mismatch (e.g., PALMETTO_OLD_123 vs. PAL-EXT-987) we'll raise a tenant rebind with Ariba support.
- We'll validate DUNS and VAT against your supplier profile before asking Ariba to rebind to avoid duplicate profiles.
- Propose a 30-minute screen-share tomorrow to align and confirm when POs will route. Are you available 2027-08-16 at 10:00 AM PT or 2:00 PM PT?

I've opened an internal ticket (PRO-3421) to track work and will paste status into this thread. CC'ing Lauren (our partner onboarding lead) in case we need to coordinate a manual PO push if the rebind takes longer than expected.

On Sun, Aug 15, 2027 at 09:12 AM Clara Nguyen <clara@palmetto-supplies.com> wrote:
> We tried to accept the supplier invite that was sent from Redwood last week but the Ariba claim flow fails at the tenant mapping step....

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive 
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Nguyen <clara@palmetto-supplies.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Issue claiming Ariba invite — org ID appears incorrect

Hi Clara, Jordan — I dug into the invite metadata and we issued the invite using the tenant alias stored in our legacy mapping: "PALMETTO_OLD_123". On Palmetto's supplier profile we can see the public-facing org ID is "PAL-EXT-987" (matches the CSV Clara sent).

Action items I recommend right now:
1) Clara: Please submit a tenant rebind request to Ariba Support referencing the Ariba SR template we use (I attached a short draft - tenant_rebind-request.docx). In the request include your preferred target org ID (PAL-EXT-987), DUNS, VAT, and a note that "Redwood's invites are being issued to PALMETTO_OLD_123".
2) Jordan/Redwood: Once Ariba issues a ticket we will confirm mapping on our side and either re-issue invites or request Ariba to migrate the invites to the correct tenant.
3) Clara: Confirm whether you want us to hold off on reissuing invites until Ariba completes the rebind or if you prefer immediate reissue to the existing legacy alias (we'll need a manual failover).

I've attached the draft tenant rebind request that Palmetto can copy into Ariba support. If helpful, I can open the Ariba support case myself with Palmetto's authorization.

On Sun, Aug 15, 2027 at 10:03 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Clara — thanks for the heads up and for the attachments...

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Attachments: tenant_rebind-request.docx

From: Clara Nguyen <clara@palmetto-supplies.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement-tech@palmetto-supplies.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Issue claiming Ariba invite — org ID appears incorrect

Hi Aditya / Jordan — quick update: we submitted the Ariba support request this morning and received SR-112233 as the confirmation number (see attached automated PDF from Ariba). We included the requested DUNS/VAT and asked that Ariba rebind the legacy alias PALMETTO_OLD_123 to PAL-EXT-987.

For the short-term, please go ahead and hold reissuing invites until Ariba confirms the rebind; we'd prefer not to create duplicate supplier records. If you can monitor SR-112233 and ping us when the mapping is updated that would be great.

Thanks for the quick help — we'll wait on your confirmation before we accept any new invites.

Best regards,
Clara Nguyen
Procurement Ops Manager
Palmetto Supplies Ltd.
Attachments: ariba-support-sr-112233.pdf
